720	And where did he make Israel die of thirst?	E onde ele fez Israel morrer de sede?
721	Rashi says: where did it really happen that Yishmael made Israel die of thirst?	Rashi diz: onde isso realmente aconteceu, que Yishmael fez Israel morrer de sede?
722	The answer: when Nebuchadnezzar exiled them, as it says, "Oracle in Arabia... bring water to meet the thirsty."	A resposta: quando Nevuchadnetsar os exilou, como está dito: "Sentença sobre a Arábia... tragam água ao encontro do sedento."
723	When they were led toward the Arabs, Israel would say to their captors: please take us to our cousins,	Quando eram levados aos árabes, Israel dizia aos captores: por favor, levem-nos aos nossos primos,
724	the Yishmaelites, and they will have mercy on us.	os filhos de Yishmael, e eles terão compaixão de nós.
725	As it says "the caravans of Dedanim." Don't read "Dedanim" but "dodim," and these go out	Como está dito "as caravanas de Dedanim". Não leia "Dedanim", mas "dodim" (primos), e estes saem
726	to meet them and bring them meat, salted fish and inflated skins. Israel thought they were full of water.	ao encontro deles e trazem carne, peixe salgado e odres inflados. Israel achava que estavam cheios de água.
727	But when one puts it to his mouth and opens it, the wind enters his body and he dies.	Mas quando se leva à boca e se abre, o vento entra no corpo e ele morre.
728	Already then they were like that.	Já naquela época eles eram assim.
729	"And Elokim opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water, and she went"	"E Elokim abriu os olhos dela, e ela viu um poço de água, e foi"

731	She went, filled the skin with water and gave the boy to drink. "And Elokim was"	Ela foi, encheu o odre de água e deu de beber ao menino. "E Elokim estava"
732	"with the boy, and he grew, and he lived in the wilderness, and became an archer."	"com o menino, e ele cresceu, e viveu no deserto, e tornou-se arqueiro."

734	shooting arrows with a bow.	atirando flechas com o arco.
735	"Keshet," by his trade, like chamar, gamal, tzayad, because of the dagesh in the letter.	"Keshet", pelo ofício, como chamar, gamal, tzayad, por causa do dagesh na letra.
736	He lived in the wilderness and robbed passersby, as it says, "his hand against all,	Vivia no deserto e assaltava os que passavam, como está dito: "sua mão contra todos,
